confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on mixed-date web results: Numbeo listings for Koh Lanta, Krabi and Koh Samui, a Koh Lanta bar menu, travel guides and one older forum post. Beer, coffee and inexpensive-meal anchors are best supported. Cocktail and wine anchors rest on sparse Koh Lanta listings and were cross-checked against the local beer relationship, at roughly twice the beer price. Baht prices were converted at an approximate rate from general knowledge, not a live quote. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge with no accommodation search, so they are lower confidence and could vary widely by room type, season and resort.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink prices are anchored on Koh Lanta-specific listings and cross-checked against Numbeo snapshots for Krabi and Koh Samui, which were in a similar range, plus Thailand-wide averages. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for a quieter Andaman island in the July green (low) season.
